slot.intent: The share price fell in every year from 2019 to 2022, when the company was delisted.

data.takeaway: The share price fell every year

concept: The line is drawn a year at a time as each is spoken, the ground filling behind the pen; it slows into a hollow red ring waiting at 2022, which fills as the last value lands.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "Share": the kicker SHARE PRICE, USD builds word by word in small tracked caps, and the hairline baseline draws across
2.0 s, on "2019,": 2019 lands under the first point and 98 above it; the pen sets off, the ground under the line filling with a flat pale tone behind it
3.0 s, on "2020,": the pen reaches 2020 as it is spoken, 71 settling above the point, and draws on at the same steady pace
4.0 s, on "2021,": the pen reaches 2021 and 34; a hollow red ring appears low at the 2022 point and waits as the pen draws on toward it, slowing all the way into it
6.0 s, on "2022:": the pen reaches the ring as the year is spoken; the ring fills red and 6 lands in red above it, the size of every other value
7.0 s, on "delisted.": DELISTED settles in red tracked caps, centred under the 2022 label, one red endpoint with the ring and the 6; a full hold to the end

leansOn.title: Bar chart (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: Values in small bold mono beside their marks, a tracked caps kicker and labels, the endpoint in red, no marks that carry no data.
